QuestInfo.name: Find the Legendary Black Dragon Wings!
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra mentioned that she heard something about the Black Dragon, a friend of the Demon Slayer. What could it be about?
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra said that she recently met the Legendary Black Dragon, who lost its wings and can no longer use its mystical powers. Help the Legendary Black Dragon by finding its wings.
QuestInfo.2: Find the mystical wings and bring them to the Legendary Black Dragon.\nThe Legendary Black Dragon will share some of its powers with you as a show of gratitude.\nNow you can enjoy Legends with the new powers you've received!

0.0: I recently met the Legendary Black Dragon, a friend of the Demon Slayer, and heard an amazing story.
0.1: The Legendary Black Dragon lost its wings during a battle, and can no longer use its mystical powers. Do you think you might be able to help the poor Black Dragon by finding its wings?
0.2: I'm sure that the Legendary Black Dragon will reward you.

yes.0:
Great! If you bring me the Legendary Wings, I'll make sure to deliver them to the Legendary Black Dragon.
It won't be easy to find the wings, but I'm sure you can do it.

no.0: You don't want to help a legendary dragon with fantastic powers? If you say so...

1.0:
You did it! You found the Legendary Wings! That dragon's going to be so happy. Thank you very much! 
I'll deliver these wings to the Legendary Black Dragon.
1.1:
The Legendary Black Dragon wanted to reward you for helping it.
This is the Legendary Black Dragon Gift Box, containing fantastic powers. 
Now you can enjoy Legends with the new powers you've received!

item.0: Still working on those Legendary Black Dragon Wings? Don't worry! I know you'll get me 50 of them in no time!

yes.0:
The Legendary Black Dragon says that it is still missing some of its mystical powers.
If you can find just a few more Legendary Wings, something wonderful will happen. Good luck!
